chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from one of his companions, from al-Ala' ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:

I was with Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) at the funeral of a man from our companions. So when they buried him, he (peace be upon him) stood at his grave and threw soil upon it from the side facing his head three times with his handful. Then he spread his palm upon the grave and said: 'O Allah! Widen the earth for him on his two sides, and ascend his soul to You, and grant him pleasure from You, and settle in his grave from Your mercy that which makes him independent of the mercy of anyone other than You.' Then he went away.

key_terms.جَافِ الْأَرْضَ: Widen/expand the earth (referring to the grave)
key_terms.حَثَى: To throw or scatter soil with the hand

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended method for spreading soil on a grave and the associated supplication according to Shia tradition?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) demonstrated the recommended etiquette of spreading soil specifically from the head side, a practice emphasized by Shia jurists as a sunnah of the Prophet and Imams. The accompanying supplication invokes divine mercy to ensure the deceased's self-sufficiency in Allah's grace, reflecting the Shia theological emphasis on intercession and the spiritual state of the soul immediately after burial.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, form one of his companions, from Al A’ala Bin Razeyn, from Muhammad Bin Muslim who said,

‘I was with Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> in a funeral of a man from our companions. So when they buried him, he<sup>asws</sup> stood at his grave and spread (soil) upon him, from what followed his head, three times with his<sup>asws</sup> handful. Then he<sup>asws</sup> spread his<sup>asws</sup> palm upon the grave, then said, ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Expand the ground from both his sides, and Ascend his soul to You<sup>azwj</sup> and let him Get Pleasure from You<sup>asws</sup>, and Settle Your<sup>azwj</sup> Mercy in his grave what would make him to be needless from a mercy besides Yours<sup>azwj</sup>’. Then he<sup>asws</sup> went away’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from certain individuals of his people from ‘Ala’ ibn Razin from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following:

“I was with abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, in a funeral procession for one of our companions. When they buried him, he (the Imam) stood up next to his grave, then filled soil toward his head, three handfuls. He then extended his palm over the grave, and then said, ‘O Allah make earth spacious on his both sides, raise his spirit to Yourself and grant him happiness from Your side and settle his grave with Your mercy so much so that it suffices him of the mercy of all things other than Your mercy,’ then he (the Imam) left.”
